thread:
sophia: Customer hit 400 on POST /v1/rerank — says it worked yesterday. Error from our side: "Invalid request: missing items". Customer pasted the body they sent:

```json
{
  "request_id": "cust-789",
  "candidates": null,
  "top_k": 5,
  // truncated — they said their client library batched multiple requests into one stream
```

sophia: They also attached a captured curl that looks like the JSON got split over TCP chunks (we see a missing closing bracket). Asking for help repro'ing. :eyes:

ingress-bot: req=req_abcd1234 route=/v1/rerank status=400 proto=HTTP/1.1 parse_error=Unexpected EOF body_bytes=342

ajay: Can you paste the exact curl they used (headers + body) and the client SDK/version? Also any proxy in front of them?

sophia: Here's the curl they provided, verbatim:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "request_id": "cust-789",
    "items": [
      {"id": "q1", "query": "best hotels"}
    ],
    "candidates": [
      {"id": "c1", "text": "Hotel A"},
      {"id": "c2", "text": "Hotel B"}
    ],
'  # <--- trailing comma, newline, body truncated by client lib
```

lina: This looks like a client-side streaming/fragmentation issue. We've seen mobile SDKs where a proxy (nginx or mobile network) splits the body and the Content-Length header doesn't match, resulting in our parser hitting EOF before the JSON completes. Ask customer for raw bytes or enable request logging on their side.

ajay: Repro steps for us: try sending the same payload but intentionally truncate after the last comma to see if our parser returns the same message. Also try sending with Transfer-Encoding: chunked to mimic client behavior. I'll spin up a quick repro.

jack: Short-term triage: add a clearer validation error (items must be non-empty array) and log the first 1KB of the received body on parse errors (PII-scrubbed) so support can see fragmentation without customer capture. I'll open a small canary PR for the handler. :hammer_and_wrench:

sophia: I asked the customer to re-send a single-line JSON (no pretty-printing) and to bypass their proxy. Provided this curl (one-liner) and asked for full raw request bytes.

sophia: Customer replied a minute later: after switching to single-line JSON the request succeeded. They believe their mobile proxy was reassembling incorrectly. They will upgrade their SDK.

sophia: Marking resolved for now, will follow up if they hit again. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
